new.name: command_field
new.source:
fn command_field(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      let found = filter(\(x) -> fst(x) == key, xs)
      demand(length(found) == 1, "INVALID_COMMAND")
      snd(at(found, 0))
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_COMMAND")
      JNull

new.name: command_fields
new.source:
fn command_fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_COMMAND")
      demand(all(\(n) -> length(filter(\(x) -> fst(x) == n, xs)) == 1, names), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    _ => reject("INVALID_COMMAND")

fn live_tables(database : List(Table)) : List(LiveTable) =

new.name: validate_change_shape
new.source:
fn validate_change_shape(c : Json) : Unit =
  let op = command_text(command_field(c, "op"))
  if op == "insert" || op == "update" then
    command_fields(c, ["op", "table", "id", "row"])
    let table = command_text(command_field(c, "table"))
    demand(bare_name(table), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match command_field(c, "id") of
      JInt(n) => demand(n >= 1 && n <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
      _ => reject("INVALID_COMMAND")
    let ignored = command_arr(command_field(c, "row"))
    ()
  elif op == "delete" then
    command_fields(c, ["op", "table", "id"])
    let table = command_text(command_field(c, "table"))
    demand(bare_name(table), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    match command_field(c, "id") of
      JInt(n) => demand(n >= 1 && n <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
      _ => reject("INVALID_COMMAND")
    ()
  else
    reject("INVALID_COMMAND")
    ()

new.name: validate_row
new.source:
fn validate_row(schema : Table, row : Json) : List(Json) =
  let xs =
    match row of
      JArr(rs) => rs
      _ =>
        reject("INVALID_ROW")
        []
  demand(length(xs) == length(schema.columns), "INVALID_ROW")
  for i in srange(0, length(xs)) do
    demand(value_type(at(xs, i)) == at(schema.columns, i).kind || value_type(at(xs, i)) == "null" && at(schema.columns, i).nullable, "INVALID_ROW")
  xs
